messages:
alex r: Quick question — trying to map the TTFT -> token flow for the new chat route (/v1/generate). Where should I look for the end-to-end panels (p50/p95/p99 + tokens/sec + traces)?

maria g: Start with Runtime -> Latency Overview in Grafana. Panels: 'TTFT by route', 'Tokens/sec by model', and the pxx heatmap. Link: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/rt-latency/overview (hit the route filter). :point_up:

alex r: Thanks — any PromQL snippets for p95 on TTFT? Want to add a quick adhoc alert for the canary.

jin: Use the request duration histogram. Example PromQL:```histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(runtime_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/generate"}[5m])) by (le))``` That gives p95 over 5m. For TTFT specifically filter span_type="ttft" in the metric if available.

samir: For tokens/sec try:```sum(rate(runtime_tokens_generated_total{model=~"gpt.*",route="/v1/generate"}[1m])) by (route)``` We visualize that as tokens/sec per route.

maria g: Note on dashboards — the 'Route Latency Explorer' has a link to Jaeger traces in the hover menu (click the p95 point). Jaeger link format: https://jaeger.redwood.company/trace/{{trace_id}}

alex r: Great — for the canary, what p95 threshold should I use before paging? Current baseline for /v1/generate is ~ 220ms p95.

devon: For canaries we usually alert at baseline * 2.5 or absolute > 1s, whichever is lower impact. So set a warning at 600ms and page at 1s for now. Also add a suppression window of 10m to avoid flakes.

samir: FYI set the alert to evaluate over 5m with 1m steps to match the hist quantile window. That reduces noise from bursts.

maria g: If you want automated runbook links in the alert, use the alert template name: `rt-ttft-canary` and add runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.company/rt-ttft-canary. It contains steps: check tokens/sec, check recent model rollouts, check kv-cache hit rates.

alex r: One more — how do we detect slow-token generation (i.e., tokens/sec drop) vs overall TTFT increase?

jin: Compare two charts side-by-side: TTFT p95 and tokens/sec per-route. If TTFT rises but tokens/sec steady, likely model latency or GPU contention. If tokens/sec drops then investigate batching, queue length, or request throttling. Use this PromQL pair:```p95_ttft = histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(runtime_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/generate"}[5m])) by (le,route))
tokens = sum(rate(runtime_tokens_generated_total{route="/v1/generate"}[1m])) by (route)```

observability-bot: Deploy notice: new runtime rollout completed at 1893452000 by infra-deploy-bot — if you see correlated spikes between 1893452000-1893452600, consider rollback.

devon: Also add a 'warmup' synthetic every 2m from canary agents to keep KV cache warm; covered in runbook but worth calling out.

alex r: Awesome — I'll add the ad-hoc panels + alerts and link the runbook. Ping me if you want to review thresholds before enabling paging. :thumbsup:

maria g: Happy to review — ping me in thread when you have the alert JSON.

samir: lgtm, let me know if you want me to wire the alert to incidents routing.

alex r: Will do, thanks everyone!
